name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [development, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [development, master]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

# A newer push to the same PR supersedes its older run, which frees runners on the org's shared job limit.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Electron Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      electron: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.electron }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2

      # Pushes always package every platform; PRs package Windows and Apple Silicon only when Electron, packaging,
      # or production build inputs change, since those jobs are the only Windows/macOS builds a PR gets.
      - name: Check packaging inputs
        id: filter
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: |
          # The PR merge commit's first parent is the base branch tip.
          changed=$(git diff --no-renames --name-only HEAD^1 HEAD)
          printf '%s\n' "$changed"
          if printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -qE '^(electron/|forge\.config\.js$|vite\.config\.js$|package\.json$|yarn\.lock$|\.yarnrc\.yml$|public/(icon|windows-icon)|scripts/(static-shell/|vite-[^/]+\.mjs$|generate-asset-manifest\.js$|banners\.mjs$|sync-directories\.js$|find-forge-executable\.js$|verify-electron-native-modules\.js$)|\.github/workflows/ci\.yml$)'; then
            echo "electron=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "electron=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  checks:
    name: Tests + Static Checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js v22
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - run: corepack enable

      - name: Resolve Yarn cache path
        id: yarn-cache
        shell: bash
        run: echo "dir=$(corepack yarn config get cacheFolder)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Cache Yarn package tarballs
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.yarn-cache.outputs.dir }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-yarn-v2-${{ hashFiles('yarn.lock', 'package.json', '.yarnrc.yml') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-yarn-v2-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          for i in 1 2 3; do
            echo "yarn install attempt $i"
            yarn install --immutable && break
            sleep 5
            [ "$i" = "3" ] && exit 1
          done

      - name: Check AI workflows
        run: |
          yarn ai-workflow:check
          yarn ai-workflow:test

      - name: Lint
        run: yarn lint

      - name: Type check
        run: yarn type-check

      - name: React Doctor diagnostics
        run: yarn doctor:check

          PERF_BASE: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.base.sha || (github.event.before != '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' && github.event.before) || '' }}

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
